purpose: Owns one independently compiled semantic namespace and its canonical import edges.
Carries hard requirements whose compatible union must be satisfied by the final target.
Carries nominal identity, complete layout, and ABI classification without backend spellings.
Carries source-visible declaration identity, private ownership, and the canonical declaration facts not owned by a specialized record.
Carries an exact Wyst import or an explicit extern-C assertion, including target, alias, selections, and re-export visibility.
Carries explicit strong, weak, or hidden native linkage for an ordinary declaration or one concrete generic definition; pub is excluded.

Carries the exact callable, ABI, structural-trust, canonical unordered concurrency/storage guarantees, outcome-qualified returned-payload leases, and authenticated direct-entry execution-level product used by consumers.
Carries typed named-layout facts; final addresses are excluded.
Carries declared and proved effect facts.
Carries a mandatory inline semantic body and its closed private dependency set.
Carries a generic semantic body with typed built-in or static-interface parameter constraints and authenticated operation requirements, without a concrete instantiation.
Carries one canonical demand plus the source selector used to authenticate its local declaration or import edge; native-linker instantiation is excluded.

Carries the deterministic compiler owner and complete comparable contract of one materialized definition, including selected static-interface dependency digests and consumer-owned imported instantiations.
Carries a private fact required to consume an inline or generic body without entering source lookup.
Carries one template-relative per-CPU entry; TLS and process addresses are excluded.
Carries section ownership and ordering without a final address.
Carries authenticated single-instruction checked-assembly provenance.
Carries semantic relocation authority; concrete ELF relocation instances and placement are excluded.
Carries parameter ownership modes, structural value abilities, terminal-origin authorities, and outcome-qualified returned-payload provenance.
Carries offered interactive protocol facts.
Carries interactive call and handler-entry contracts.
Carries exact direct suspension and provider requirements.
Carries complete resumable-frame facts without a live instance.
Carries explicit entry, export, init, section, vector, verification, or address roots.
Carries normalized diagnostic locations; it never participates in semantic identity.
Carries typed ordered observable-result, precondition, and postcondition facts without changing callable ABI identity.
Carries one nominal compile-time operation set, its compiler-proved carrier ability, complete canonical callable contracts, and their digests; it is not a runtime type.
Carries the unique subject-owned mapping from a static interface operation to an ordinary declaration, callable-conformance evidence, and compiler-owned hidden bridge.
